name: h
description: Portable Kie-only batch and single workflow with an embedded runtime.

interface.shortDescription: Portable fixed Kie workflows with no Python installation.
interface.longDescription: H runs Kie-only workflows through one deterministic Chinese menu protocol with two modes: recursive whole-folder concurrent batch processing and one-model single processing. Platform-specific portable packages embed the runtime and dependencies, install through a local personal marketplace without requiring Python, pip, Homebrew, Git, or the Codex CLI, validate Kie before generation, save task IDs for safe resume, validate downloaded media, and write Desktop text, image, and video folders on Windows and Intel or Apple Silicon macOS.
defaultPrompt: 使用 H 批量处理整个 PID 产品文件夹。
使用 H 单独调用一个 Kie 文本、图像或视频模型。
使用 H 继续已保存的 Kie 生成任务。
